title: DocumentUploaded, version 1
description: core to ai: a document version was stored in blob storage and waits for ingestion.

blobPath.description: tenants/{tenantId}/establishments/{establishmentId}/documents/{documentId}/versions/{versionId}/{file}, ids lower case. The AI service refuses a path outside tenants/{tenantId}/.

contentType.description: The media type the core accepted, without parameters: application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, text/plain or text/csv. Anything else fails with unsupported_format.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lower-case hex.
